statement.zh: 每个外推都有一个开放的历程，使它提出的每个值都不合；无前段固定下一个值。被列表所持的世界中不合有界、停息不能被否证且只在那里停息，何时停息不显出；对类的学习是同一学习。
statement.en: Every extrapolation has an open course on which each value it proposes misses; no prefix fixes the next value. In a world held by a list the misses are bounded, coming to rest is unrefuted and happens only there, and when does not show; learning over classes is the same learning.

claim.zh: 历程 o : Nat → O 是值的序列（例如确定律之轨道经映射所读）；第 t 步之前的前段 prefixOf o t（最新在前）；外推是任意从前段到所提出之值或默的映射 pred : List O → Option O；所提出的值不合（Misses）指它提出了一个值而来到的值不同；候选在历程上相合（Accords）指它在任何一步都不不合。不加前提：对每个历程与每步 t，给出两个不同的值，有两个历程与它在 t 之前前段相同、在 t 分别取这两个值，从该前段提出的值不在两者上都对（no_prefix_fixes_next），值可判定时在其中之一不合（claim_missed_on_one）；两者都是被列表所持之世界的历程（holdFrom_lasso、no_prefix_fixes_next_finite）。对每个外推与移动每个值的 other，对角序列 diagonal pred other x 使它提出的每个值都不合（diagonal_misses），所以在它上面外推不从任何一步起都提出且正确（diagonal_unrested）；它是保留全部前段之律的历程，没有列表持有该律的配置（prefix_diagonal、diagonal_open）。逐除外推（indexOn、byElimination：候选 H 依次排列，恰在所持者不合时移向下一个；值可判定）从不越过相合的候选：H j 相合时指标至多为 j（index_le_of_accords），外推不在任意晚处不合（misses_not_recurring）；越过的每个候选都在前段中某一步不合（missed_before）；相同的前段给出相同的候选与所提出的值（byElimination_through_prefix）。套索（Lasso o i q：从第 i 步起以周期 q + 1 重复）：确定律的轨道被列表 l 所持时，其经每个映射的历程都是套索且 i + q + 1 ≤ l.length（lasso_of_held）；每个套索都是被列表所持之世界经映射的历程（lasso_realized）。套索候选按对角次序排列（lassos、pairAt、pairAt_place）时：在套索历程上外推至多不合 tri (i + q) + q 次、从第 i + q + 1 步起每步提出、不在任意晚处不合（lasso_byElimination_bounded），它从某步起每步提出且正确这一点不能被否证（rest_unrefuted，双重否定）；它从某步起每步提出且正确时，历程是套索（lasso_of_rest）；轨道被列表 l 所持时，不合少于 tri l.length 次、从第 l.length 步起每步提出、不在任意晚处不合（held_byElimination_bounded），停息不能被否证（held_rest_unrefuted）；它的对角序列不是套索（diagonal_not_lasso）；有界不降的计数从某步起不变这一点不能被否证（stable_unrefuted）。类 G c 沿对合并（merged）时，G c j 相合则合并枚举上的外推指标至多为 tri (c + j) + j（merged_bound），而每种合并的外推在其对角序列上不停息（merged_unrested）。见证：Alternate（false, true, false, …）上外推不合两次，从第三步起每步正确（Alternate.index_three、Alternate.rests）。
claim.en: A course o : Nat → O is a sequence of values (such as a determined law's orbit read through a map); prefixOf o t is its prefix before step t, latest first; an extrapolation is any map pred : List O → Option O from a prefix to a proposed value or silence; a proposed value misses (Misses) when a value is proposed and the value that comes differs; a candidate accords with a course (Accords) when it misses at no step. With no premise: for every course and step t, given two values, two courses share its prefix before t and take the one and the other value at t, and a value proposed from that prefix is not right on both (no_prefix_fixes_next), and with values decided misses on one of them (claim_missed_on_one); both are courses of worlds held by a list (holdFrom_lasso, no_prefix_fixes_next_finite). For every extrapolation and every other moving each value, the diagonal course diagonal pred other x makes each value it proposes miss (diagonal_misses), so on it the extrapolation does not, from any step on, propose at every step and be right (diagonal_unrested); it is the course of a law keeping its whole prefix, whose configurations no list holds (prefix_diagonal, diagonal_open). Extrapolation by elimination (indexOn, byElimination: candidates H in order, moving on exactly where the one held misses; values decided) never passes a candidate that accords: where H j accords the index is at most j (index_le_of_accords) and the extrapolation does not miss at arbitrarily late steps (misses_not_recurring); every candidate passed missed within the prefix at some step (missed_before); one prefix gives one candidate and one proposed value (byElimination_through_prefix). Lassos (Lasso o i q: repeating from step i with period q + 1): where a determined law's orbit is held by a list l, its course through every map is a lasso with i + q + 1 ≤ l.length (lasso_of_held); every lasso is the course through a map of a world held by a list (lasso_realized). With the lasso candidates in diagonal order (lassos, pairAt, pairAt_place): on a lasso course the extrapolation misses at most tri (i + q) + q times, proposes at every step from step i + q + 1 on and does not miss at arbitrarily late steps (lasso_byElimination_bounded), and that from some step on it proposes at every step and is right is unrefuted (rest_unrefuted, a double negation); where from some step on it proposes at every step and is right, the course is a lasso (lasso_of_rest); where the orbit is held by a list l it misses fewer than tri l.length times, proposes at every step from step l.length on and does not miss at arbitrarily late steps (held_byElimination_bounded), its coming to rest unrefuted (held_rest_unrefuted); its diagonal course is no lasso (diagonal_not_lasso); that a bounded count that never falls is constant from some step on is unrefuted (stable_unrefuted). With classes G c merged along the pairs (merged), where G c j accords the extrapolation over the merged enumeration has index at most tri (c + j) + j (merged_bound), and the extrapolation over every merging is unrested on its diagonal course (merged_unrested). Witness: on Alternate (false, true, false, …) the extrapolation misses twice and is right at every step from the third (Alternate.index_three, Alternate.rests).

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。值可判定相等（DecidableEq O）只作为外推（逐除外推、套索外推、合并外推与 diagonal_not_lasso）与 swapTo（另一个值）的条件出现，并只在 claim_missed_on_one 与 eq_of_not_missed 的证明中用到；no_prefix_fixes_next 与 diagonal_misses、diagonal_unrested、diagonal_open 不用它（逐条见可判定性清点）。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. Decidable equality of values (DecidableEq O) appears only as a condition of the extrapolation (extrapolation by elimination, the lasso extrapolation, the merged extrapolation and diagonal_not_lasso) and of swapTo (another value), and is used only in the proofs of claim_missed_on_one and eq_of_not_missed; no_prefix_fixes_next and diagonal_misses, diagonal_unrested and diagonal_open do not use it (each is listed in the decidability inventory).

hypotheses.zh: 每条定理的条件写在其中：两个不同的值（no_prefix_fixes_next）；other 移动每个值（对角）；某个候选相合（index_le_of_accords、misses_not_recurring）；历程是套索或轨道被列表所持（lasso_byElimination_bounded、held_byElimination_bounded）。候选的列表 H 与类 G 由学习之外给出。
hypotheses.en: Each theorem's conditions are written into it: two different values (no_prefix_fixes_next); other moving every value (the diagonal); some candidate according (index_le_of_accords, misses_not_recurring); the course being a lasso or the orbit held by a list (lasso_byElimination_bounded, held_byElimination_bounded). The candidates H and the classes G are supplied from outside the learning.

hypotheses.zh: 停息只以双重否定陈述（rest_unrefuted、held_rest_unrefuted、stable_unrefuted），名称依整合者的规则带“unrefuted”：此处不给出停息之步（并未证明不能给出；P83 给出它：轨道被长 N 的列表所持时，外推从第 N + (2N − 1)·tri N 步起每步提出且正确，Identification.held_byElimination_rests，这一步由界给出，外推的前段不表明它）；“不在任意晚处不合”是“不合复现”的否定，不是“从某步起不不合”。
hypotheses.en: Coming to rest is stated only as a double negation (rest_unrefuted, held_rest_unrefuted, stable_unrefuted), the names carrying “unrefuted” under the integrator's rule: the step of rest is not stated here (not shown impossible; P83 states it: where the orbit is held by a list of length N, the extrapolation proposes and is right at every step from N + (2N − 1)·tri N on, Identification.held_byElimination_rests, a step the bound gives and the extrapolation's prefix does not show); “not missing at arbitrarily late steps” is the negation of misses recurring, not “no miss from some step on”.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12 问对元层次、人工神经网络、认知与关于学习的智慧解释得多完整；对 AI 的回答（四者都未完成，归纳问题未消解）答：“please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”。AI 读作：完成所提三步，并消解归纳问题。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：归纳被消解为规律而不是被保证；休谟的问题在 no_prefix_fixes_next；逐除外推是 Gold 意义上的极限识别，停息不显出；元层次是再学习，没有顶层（merged_unrested 的读法）；智慧不是一个完成的外推。
correspondence.en: On 12 October 2026 Ren asked how completely the meta level, artificial neural networks, cognition and the wisdom about learning are explained; to the AI's answer (none complete, induction undissolved) Ren replied “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”. The AI reads it as completing the three proposed steps and resolving the problem of induction. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): induction is resolved into laws rather than certified; Hume's problem sits at no_prefix_fixes_next; extrapolation by elimination is identification in the limit in Gold's sense, its rest not showing; the meta level is learning again, with no top (the reading of merged_unrested); wisdom is never a completed extrapolation.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.orbit、Law.process、revisits_within（有限多配置之内轨道返回）、unlisted_of_new（每步新的律不被列表所持）、gap_of_le、gap_of_lt、mem_cons_split。增量是把返回读到经映射的历程上：被列表所持的轨道经映射的历程是套索，保留全部前段之律的历程是对角序列。
detail.en: Reuses Law.orbit, Law.process, revisits_within (within finitely many configurations the orbit returns), unlisted_of_new (a law new at every step is held by no list), gap_of_le, gap_of_lt and mem_cons_split. The delta reads return off the course through a map: the course through a map of an orbit held by a list is a lasso, and the course of a law keeping its whole prefix is the diagonal course.

output.zh: 有限多配置之内轨道返回；每步新的律不被列表所持。
output.en: Within finitely many configurations the orbit returns; a law new at every step is held by no list.

input.zh: 被列表所持之世界经映射的历程是套索；对角序列的世界开放。
input.en: The course through a map of a world held by a list is a lasso; the diagonal course's world is open.

detail.zh: P49 的 Web.tail_unexcluded（没有模型，有限前段不排除关于其后的主张）是水平历史上的同一规律；这里对任意历程陈述（no_prefix_fixes_next），并给出它的正面一侧：被列表所持的世界中逐除外推的不合有界。
detail.en: P49's Web.tail_unexcluded (without a model no finite prefix excludes a claim about what follows) is the same law for level histories; here it is stated for every course (no_prefix_fixes_next), with its positive side: in a world held by a list extrapolation by elimination misses a bounded number of times.

output.zh: 主张只经耦合入者的差别被排除；无模型时前段不排除关于其后的主张。
output.en: A claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in; without a model the prefix excludes no claim about what follows.

input.en: Misses and learning on a course.

conditions.zh: 映射之值能被分辨（逐除外推处）。
conditions.en: Values through the map that can be told apart (for extrapolation by elimination).

detail.zh: 那里记录只在取过之处固定一个动作的结果；这里前段不固定下一个值，套索的返回就是使学习停息的返回。
detail.en: There the record fixes an act's outcome only where taken; here the prefix fixes no next value, and a lasso's return is the return that lets learning come to rest.

detail.zh: 那里说一个关于何者无关的模型何时正确；这里说从前段选出模型的学习何时停息。
detail.en: There, when a model of what is irrelevant is right; here, when learning that selects a model from the prefix comes to rest.

detail.zh: 归纳的规律是科学探究的必要关系的一部分；本记录不证明完整核心对科学的不可或缺性。
detail.en: The laws of induction are part of the necessary relations of scientific inquiry; this record does not prove the whole core indispensable to science.

detail.zh: 映射不分辨配置之处：某个外推在每个配置上停息，恰当经映射的未来相同的配置其特征从某步起一致；外推仍须分辨经映射的值。
detail.en: Where the map does not tell configurations apart: some extrapolation rests at every configuration exactly where configurations with the same future through the map have features agreeing from some step on; the extrapolation still tells the values through the map apart.

detail.zh: 没有外推在每个历程上停息：对角序列使它提出的每个值都不合（diagonal_unrested），套索外推的对角序列不是套索（diagonal_not_lasso）。
detail.en: No extrapolation rests on every course: the diagonal course makes each value it proposes miss (diagonal_unrested), and the lasso extrapolation's diagonal course is no lasso (diagonal_not_lasso).

limitations.zh: 一个实际形成持有哪些候选或类、它经映射的值能否被分辨、它的世界是否被列表所持，不推出；界 tri N 粗，不是最优；只陈述确定的、逐值的学习，概率的或近似的学习（PAC）、可数类的一般学习理论、计算的复杂性没有陈述；主要定理是学习理论中已知结果（Putnam 1963 的对角、Gold 1967 与 Putnam 1965 的极限识别、Gold 的枚举法、Kelly 1996）在脊柱上的形式，增量是与耦合、实验、机制与选择接为一体；读法除理之外是 AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: Which candidates or classes an actual formation holds, whether its values through a map can be told apart and whether its world is held by a list are not derived; the bound tri N is coarse, not optimal; only determined, value-by-value learning is stated, and probabilistic or approximate learning (PAC), the general theory of countable classes and computational complexity are not; the main theorems are known results of learning theory (Putnam's 1963 diagonal, identification in the limit after Gold 1967 and Putnam 1965, Gold's enumeration method, Kelly 1996) in the spine's form, the delta being their integration with coupling, experiment, mechanism and selection; the readings other than 理 are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; contains no ethical predicate.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T094743.528770Z）：Becoming.Learning 的 75 项定理全部空依赖，其中含 no_prefix_fixes_next、claim_missed_on_one、diagonal_misses、diagonal_open、index_le_of_accords、misses_not_recurring、held_byElimination_bounded、held_rest_unrefuted与 merged_unrested；同一回执覆盖包内 75 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 4518 项定理／6370 项声明审计，22 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 77 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §92；尚无独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 75 theorems of Becoming.Learning all have empty axiom reports, among them no_prefix_fixes_next, claim_missed_on_one, diagonal_misses, diagonal_open, index_le_of_accords, misses_not_recurring, held_byElimination_bounded, held_rest_unrefuted and merged_unrested; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §92 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

next_delta.zh: 经映射的值本身不被分辨时的学习（映射不分辨配置时的可学性见 learnable-through-registration）；概率的读法；与 registration-within-what-it-registers（在所读之中的读法族在每一步不完备）的连接。
next_delta.en: Learning where the values through the map themselves are not told apart (learnability where the map does not tell configurations apart is in learnable-through-registration); a probabilistic reading; the connection with registration-within-what-it-registers (a family of readings within what it reads, incomplete at every step).

The claim is unchanged.
